A man with dark hair and a black hoodie reaches down to grab two cardboard boxes. (3) The man stands up, holding a medium-sized brown cardboard box with both hands. He is in an indoor setting with a treadmill visible in the background and bright indoor lighting. (4) On a white marble-patterned countertop, hands with a gold ring on the right index finger open the brown box to reveal a white inner box with 'MR-G' printed on it. (5) The hands open the white box to reveal a high-gloss black wooden watch box. The man's black sleeve is visible as he carefully lifts the lid. (7) A close-up shows hands peeling a protective plastic film off the watch band. The 'MR-G' logo is engraved on the metal clasp. (8) Detailed macro shots follow, showing the watch face with 'CASIO', 'MR-G', and 'G-SHOCK' branding. The hands of the watch move over a black textured dial with red accents and gold-colored hour markers. (9) The scene shifts to a cinematic montage of a samurai in red 'Akazonae' armor. He is shown adjusting his helmet and standing on a battlefield with red flags. Other soldiers are seen charging into battle. (10) The visual returns to macro shots of the watch, specifically focusing on the red and gold screws on the bezel. White text overlays explain technical specifications like 'B2000B' and 'DLC titanium'. (11) The man is shown wearing the watch on his left wrist. He looks at the camera while holding the watch up, gesturing with his hands as he speaks in a medium close-up shot. The background is a modern home interior.
